description:
Return counted arrivals beside Meta outbound clicks for the authorized workspace and selected trailing window. difference is arrivals.value minus claimed_clicks; positive means more arrivals than Meta outbound clicks. conversions.count counts retained logical conversions under the current workspace conversion choices, independently of arrivals and Meta acceptance; the block publishes its selection version, completed local-day period, and availability. purchases.plainrouter_accepted_purchases counts only non-test, observed, attribution-joined Purchases Plainrouter sent and Meta accepted, beside Meta-reported Purchase counts under the account attribution setting, with no purchase gap or status; its eligibility differs from conversions.count, and its account-local window ends the day before Meta's latest purchase read, so it can end earlier than conversions.period; with no purchase read it covers conversions.period and window_start_date and window_end_date are null. purchases.plainrouter_accepted_purchases is null when it was not measured: the account timezone is missing or invalid, there is no destination account, no account-local day of the purchase window is retained, or part of the window is older than retained delivery records; null means unavailable, while 0 is a measured zero. An unavailable status from missing Meta data still carries measured arrivals; only the status_message 'No complete retained day is available for this comparison period.' pairs unavailable with arrivals.value 0 by convention, not a measured zero. channel_subset.rows[].arrivals counts consented conversion events by source, not arrivals; these rows are not a breakdown of arrivals.value and need not sum to it. claimed_clicks_source of manual means a person entered the click counts; mixed means differing sources, which may include manual entries or legacy rows with unknown provenance. Unless the destination is inactive, claimed_clicks adds Meta's click counts for each account-timezone day; if any day in the period has a non-zero UTC offset, platform_impressions and platform_spend are null and platform_daily shows not_yet_read. With an inactive destination that still reads Meta, claimed_clicks, platform_impressions and platform_spend are summed over UTC days picked by the account-timezone date labels, so for an account outside UTC they cover a shifted span. Days before 2026-06-29, or not re-read by the daily sync since 2026-09-27, may still hold Meta link clicks or all clicks.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

days.description: Trailing window in days. One of 7, 30, 90.

months.description: Trailing window of 12 calendar months, in place of days. Offered only where the workspace plan keeps that history and the workspace is set to keep it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_arrivals_comparison

plainrouter_accepted_purchases.description: Count of Purchases Plainrouter sent and Meta accepted; null means unavailable because it was not measured: the account timezone is missing or invalid, there is no eligible destination for the account, no account-local day of the purchase window is retained, or part of the window is older than retained delivery records. A measured zero remains 0.
